t: The Bosch PRO Wood Circular Saw Blade has an extra-thin kerf to deliver precise cuts and extend battery runtime. Strong carbide teeth, and expansion cooling slots, ensure long cutting life in solid wood and wood-based panel materials. Suitable for use on softwood, hardwood, veneered boards, plywood, one-side laminated chipboard, MDF, hardboard and veneers.
b: Suitable for cutting Softwood, Hardwood, Veneered Boards, Plywood, One-Side Laminated Chipboard, MDF, Hardboard & Veneers
